# Frozen static native Linux comparison fixtures

Inputs are the unchanged accepted bridge-v2 A/B trees. The additive retained-macos
A/B trees were rendered with the actual existing Mac rsvg-convert2.57.0;
reference.json records the observation, including dirty preparation provenance.
Lock production source hashes, not a clean-looking Git label, bind the producer.
A is the retained factual Cape Canaveral source example. B is controlled synthetic
palette/position update data, never a surveyed correction or current launch.

All original v1/v2 bytes are external inputs and must remain exact. Reference
output contains only original SpaceFox-produced JSON/SFR1 data. Geography keeps
its existing Natural Earth/source provenance from bridge-v2 and repository
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; no third-party photos, PDF pages, SDK or credentials are
included. Full native, physical, live provider and Linux acceptance are separate.
See docs/NATIVE_LINUX_QUALIFICATION.md and .github/native-linux-static-lock.json.
